title: 第19章 人性之恶第20章 终于现身的幕后之人
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
小镇之中，在贝儿家中耐心等待李凯南归来的的布兰妮，终于还是在第三天的时候坐不住了！
被诅咒的城堡并不远，莫里斯从里面出来的时候甚至只用了半天时间。
按理来说，李凯南应该已经回来了。
但是他并没有，或许是遇到了什么困难？
小姑娘一时之间有些六神无主，急得直掉眼泪。
在强迫自己冷静下来之后，布兰妮当即便写信让贝儿的父亲莫里斯找人送去瑞普森林，向自己的外婆和老猎人求救。
按理来说，布兰妮已经选择向家人求救，此时最明智的选择就应该等待自己的外婆和老猎人赶来支援。
但是不要指望这个年龄的小姑娘做事多么妥帖，能够在自己心上人身处危险之中的情况下保持冷静！
布兰妮直接擦去了自己的眼泪，打定主意现在就前去城堡救援。
她不知道李凯南遇到了什么事情，但或许自己只要及时赶到，就能帮他脱离危险呢……
而莫里斯现在是既担心女儿的安危，也因为李凯南极有可能已经遇难而心存愧疚。
他不愿意再让布兰妮去冒险，跟在她的身后努力劝说着。
但布兰妮却是无比执拗，说什么也不愿意继续等着。
也就在布兰妮和莫里斯一边争执，一边走到小镇上酒馆门前的时候。
号称小镇上“最勇武之人”的加斯顿注意到了布兰妮的身影，立马从酒馆之中走了出来，拦住布兰妮故作绅士地道：
“这位美丽的小姐，很抱歉我并非是故意偷听你们之间对话的。但我想老莫里斯说的对，你不该独自前去那片充满危险的森林！”
“现在的情况，我认为你还是需要为自己的未来多考虑考虑……”
说话之时，加斯顿眼神不住地打量着布兰妮，还露出了自认为最完美帅气的笑容。
她可真是美丽啊！
看上去略显稚嫩的俏丽脸蛋和胸前那惊人的曲线，形成了一种强烈反差。

再加上那纯真无瑕的气质，让人心动不已。
和贝儿的美貌不同，但却都各有千秋！
哦，这些该死的贵族，眼光真是不错啊！
她应该已经和贵族上床了吧，真是可惜。
她已经没有资格做我的妻子了，但可以让她成为自己的情人……
加斯顿心中这么想着，藏着贪婪的眼神不住地打量着布兰妮。
离开家人之前，布兰妮的外婆和母亲教导了她一些事情。
小姑娘已经不再像是之前那般懵懂不知事了，正式踏上女巫之路后自身感知也越发敏锐。
她对加斯顿的眼神很是反感，带着婴儿肥的白皙俏脸瞬间就冷了下来。
就是可惜没啥威慑力，反而引得加斯顿身旁的一众跟班们纷纷应和道：
“加斯顿可是我们镇上最勇武的青年人！”
“他是个不错的归属，说不定比你的那位大人还要勇猛……嘿嘿嘿！”
“这位小姐，你的大人现在一定已经死了，你以后不如就跟着加斯顿吧！”
“……”
这些人的言辞粗鄙，甚至还有人想要直接去扯布兰妮身上的那件昂贵丝绸披风。
身穿华丽铠甲，看上去就十分勇武且尊贵的李凯南，让他们毕恭毕敬不敢有丝毫冒犯。
但此时他们都认定，李凯南已经回不来了！
content_en:
In the small town, Britney, who was patiently waiting for Li Kainan's return at Belle's house, finally couldn't sit still on the third day!
The cursed castle was not far away, and it only took Maurice half a day to get out of it.
Logically speaking, Li Kainan should have returned.
But he didn't, maybe he encountered some difficulties?
The little girl was a little confused for a moment and was so anxious that she burst into tears.
After forcing herself to calm down, Britney immediately wrote a letter asking Belle's father Maurice to find someone to send to Rip Forest to ask for help from her grandmother and the old hunter.
Logically speaking, Britney has chosen to ask for help from her family. The wisest choice at this time is to wait for her grandmother and old hunter to come to support.
But don't expect a little girl of this age to do things properly and stay calm when her sweetheart is in danger!
Britney wiped away her tears and made up her mind to go to the castle to rescue her now.
She didn't know what happened to Li Kainan, but maybe as long as she arrived in time, she could help him out of danger...
Morris is now worried about his daughter's safety, but also feels guilty because Li Kainan may have been killed.
He didn't want Britney to take risks anymore, so he followed her and tried to persuade her.
But Britney was extremely stubborn and refused to wait any longer.
Just when Britney and Morris were arguing, they walked to the door of the pub in the town.
Gaston, known as the "bravest man" in the town, noticed Britney's figure and immediately walked out of the tavern, stopped Britney and pretended to be a gentleman:
"This beautiful lady, I'm sorry that I didn't eavesdrop on your conversation on purpose. But I think Old Morris is right, you shouldn't go to that dangerous forest alone!"
"With the current situation, I think you still need to think more about your future..."
While speaking, Gaston kept looking at Britney and showed what he thought was the most perfect and handsome smile.
She is so beautiful!
The pretty face that looks slightly childish and the amazing curves on the chest form a strong contrast.
Coupled with that innocent and flawless temperament, it makes people excited.
Different from Belle’s beauty, but both have their own merits!
Oh, these damn nobles have really good eyesight!
She must have slept with the noble, what a shame.
She is no longer qualified to be my wife, but she can be my lover...
Gaston thought so in his mind, and kept looking at Britney with hidden greedy eyes.
Before she left her family, Britney's grandmother and mother taught her a few things.
The little girl is no longer as ignorant as she was before, and her senses have become sharper after she officially embarked on the journey of being a witch.
She was very disgusted by Gaston's eyes, and her pretty fair face with baby fat instantly turned cold.
It's a pity that it doesn't have much deterrence, but it caused all the followers around Gaston to agree:
"Gaston is the bravest young man in our town!"
"He is a good addition. He may be braver than your master... Hehehehe!"
"Miss, your master must be dead now. You might as well follow Gaston from now on!"
"..."
These people's remarks were vulgar, and some even wanted to directly pull the expensive silk cloak on Britney's body.
Wearing gorgeous armor, Li Kainan looked very brave and noble, so that they were respectful and did not dare to offend him in the slightest.
But at this time, they all believed that Li Kainan could not come back!
